covers: the content arm's tf-idf index and cosine ranker (lib/kernel/ranker.js): per-doc norms and df over a mixed corpus, prototype-key tokens (constructor/toString/__proto__/hasOwnProperty — the NaN-norm class, issue-cc-gardener-near-dup-unnormalized-cosine) scoring as ordinary finite terms, an empty doc and a stopword-only doc (zero norm scores 0, never the raw dot product), repeated terms, Unicode-folded and segmented queries, an unknown-word and an empty query (all-zero ranking), excludeIds, and the incremental indexNode update + create path re-ranked against the patched index.
